# GFC development instructions

All agent instructions live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and [`docs/agents/`](../docs/agents/README.md). Start there.

Essentials: use `pnpm` only; PRs target `main`; Conventional Commits; every PR declares exactly one `Changelog-Impact: beta|hotfix|none|inherited`; verify with `pnpm run build`.
